defs.d: A foodstuff made by baking dough made from cereals.
Any variety of bread.
To coat with breadcrumbs
A very young human, particularly from birth to a couple of years old or until walking is fully mastered.

Any very young animal, especially a vertebrate; many species have specific names for their babies, such as kittens for the babies of cats, puppies for the babies of dogs, and chickens for the babies of birds. See for more.
To coddle; to pamper somebody like an infant.
To tend (something) with care; to be overly attentive to (something), fuss over.
Of a child: very young; of the age when he or she would be termed a baby or infant.
defs.ex: a baby boy

defs.d: Of an animal: young.
defs.ex: a baby elephant

defs.d: An event or community gathering, usually staged by a local community, which centers on some theme, sometimes on some unique aspect of the community.
In mythology, a set of celebrations in the honour of a god.
Pertaining to a feast or feast-day. (Now only as the noun used attributively.)
(with "the") The deep part of a lake, sea, etc.
defs.ex: creatures of the deep

defs.d: (with "the") A silent time; quiet isolation.
defs.ex: the deep of night

defs.d: (of a physical distance) Extending far away from a point of reference, especially downwards.
(intellectual, social) Complex, involved.
Deeply.
An abnormal condition of a human, animal or plant that causes discomfort or dysfunction; distinct from injury insofar as the latter is usually instantaneously acquired.
defs.ex: The tomato plants had some kind of disease that left their leaves splotchy and fruit withered.

defs.d: (by extension) Any abnormal or harmful condition, as of society, people's attitudes, way of living etc.
To cause unease; to annoy, irritate.
To infect with a disease.
Model, example.
A design, motif or decoration, especially formed from regular repeated elements.
To apply a pattern.
To make or design (anything) by, from, or after, something that serves as a pattern; to copy; to model; to imitate.
The striking of one body against another; collision.
The force or energy of a collision of two objects.
defs.ex: The hatchet cut the wood on impact.

defs.d: To collide or strike, the act of impinging.
defs.ex: When the hammer impacts the nail, it bends.

defs.d: To compress; to compact; to press into something or pack together.
defs.ex: The footprints of birds do not impact the soil in the way those of dinosaurs do.

defs.d: One who is innocent, especially a young child.
defs.ex: The slaughter of the innocents was a significant event in the New Testament.

defs.d: A harmless simple-minded person; an idiot.
Free from guilt, sin, or immorality.
Bearing no legal responsibility for a wrongful act.
Someone who is hostile to, feels hatred towards, opposes the interests of, or intends injury to someone else.
defs.ex: Crush the enemy!

defs.d: A hostile force or nation; a fighting member of such a force or nation.
defs.ex: Rally together against a common enemy.

defs.d: To make an enemy of.
Of, relating to, or belonging to an enemy
The way in which something hangs.
defs.ex: This skirt has a nice hang.

defs.d: A grip, understanding.
defs.ex: He got the hang of it after only two demonstrations.

defs.d: To be or remain suspended.
defs.ex: The lights hung from the ceiling.

defs.d: To float, as if suspended.
defs.ex: The smoke hung in the room.

defs.d: The symbol ♯, placed after the name of a note in the key signature or before a note on the staff to indicate that the note is to be played a semitone higher.
defs.ex: The pitch pipe sounded out a perfect F♯ (F sharp).

defs.d: A note that is played a semitone higher than usual; denoted by the name of the note that is followed by the symbol ♯.
To raise the pitch of a note half a step making a natural note a sharp.
defs.ex: That new musician must be tone deaf: he sharped half the notes of the song!

defs.d: To play tricks in bargaining; to act the sharper.
Terminating in a point or edge, especially one that can cut easily; not obtuse or rounded.
defs.ex: A face with sharp features

defs.d: Intelligent.
defs.ex: My nephew is a sharp lad; he can count to 100 in six languages, and he's only five years old.

defs.d: The manner in which two things may be associated.
defs.ex: The relation between diet and health is complex.

defs.d: A member of one's family.
defs.ex: Yes, he's a relation of mine, but only a distant one.

defs.d: The act of paying.
A sum of money paid in exchange for goods or services.
The highest limit
The greatest value of a set or other mathematical structure, especially the global maximum or a local maximum of a function
To the highest degree.
defs.ex: Use the proper dose for the maximum effect.

defs.d: Resistance of the air (or some other fluid) to something moving through it.
defs.ex: When designing cars, manufacturers have to take drag into consideration.

defs.d: (foundry) The bottom part of a sand casting mold.
To pull along a surface or through a medium, sometimes with difficulty.
defs.ex: Let's drag this load of wood over to the shed.

defs.d: To move onward heavily, laboriously, or slowly; to advance with weary effort; to go on lingeringly.
defs.ex: Time seems to drag when you’re waiting for a bus.

defs.d: A person, animal or plant living at a certain location or in a certain area.
defs.ex: The tiger lily is a resident of Asia.

defs.d: A bird which does not migrate during the course of the year.
Dwelling, or having an abode, in a place for a continued length of time; residing on one's own estate.
defs.ex: resident in the city or in the country

defs.d: Based in a particular place; on hand; local.
defs.ex: He is our resident computer expert.

defs.d: The head spy in a rezidentura.
A rich person.
(with "the") Rich people.
Possessing financial wealth; rich.
Abundant in quality or quantity; profuse.
